inputs.label: Virtua Cop arcade ROM sets (MAME 0.289)
inputs.help: Your own MAME 0.289 sets vcop.zip and model1io2.zip. Leave them zipped.

steps.why: The app searches all storage for the ROM sets. The guide has the user allow this in the headset.

steps.text: Open Port0r: Cop VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it. The game copies the ROM sets in and starts; until then, a setup screen lists any missing files.

notes: port0r holds every Port0r game in one repository, so the latest release is often another game; tag selects Cop VR. ^vcop-v does not match Cop 2 VR's vcop2-v tags. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
